Li-Ning G-Force 5900 Superlite — ~₹2,300. Lightweight and easy to swing; good all-round starter.

Yonex Astrox Attack 9 — ~₹1,500. Forgiving and beginner-friendly; good value.

Yonex Nanoray Light 18i — ~₹1,850. Lightweight, manoeuvrable option.

For shoes: look for dedicated badminton shoes with a non-marking gum/rubber sole, lateral support, cushioning and a snug heel fit. Around ₹2,000–₹4,000 is enough to start; shoes matter more than upgrading the racket.

For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist these three current India options. Exact managed-service pricing is generally quote-based, so don’t treat a public “₹X/month” number as reliable.

Option	Indicative total cost	Best fit	Verify before paying
MakeMyTrip myBiz	₹0 platform fee publicly listed; booking/service fees vary	Cost-conscious SME, mostly flights/hotels	Service fee per booking, 1.5% payment-gateway fee where applicable, cancellation/change fees, GST invoice, 24/7 escalation 
MakeMyTrip
+1

FCM Travel India	Custom quote; typically management/service fees + travel spend	Fully managed programme, approvals, support	Per-ticket/transaction fee, offline-agent fee, implementation fee, credit terms, SLA, cancellation handling 
FCM Travel
+1

BCD Travel India	Custom quote	Larger/complex corporate travel programme	Management fee vs transaction fee, after-hours charges, implementation, hotel/airline mark-ups, SLA and duty-of-care coverage 
BCD Travel

Practical next step: ask all three for a 12-month all-in quote based on your actual monthly flight/hotel volume, including every fee and GST. This makes the comparison meaningful rather than comparing headline pricing.
